title: Give Instructions & Give Feedback
situation: Explaining a task and reviewing work with a teammate.
objective: Use give instructions and give feedback to guide and improve work.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: Before the task, I give instructions to my teammate.
dialogue.indonesian: Sebelum tugas, saya memberi instruksi kepada rekan kerja saya.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: I give clear instructions about the safety check.
dialogue.indonesian: Saya memberi instruksi yang jelas tentang pemeriksaan keselamatan.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: After the repair, I give feedback on the work.
dialogue.indonesian: Setelah perbaikan, saya memberi masukan tentang pekerjaan itu.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: My supervisor gives feedback about my report.
dialogue.indonesian: Supervisor saya memberi masukan tentang laporan saya.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: Good feedback helps us do the next task better.
dialogue.indonesian: Masukan yang baik membantu kami mengerjakan tugas berikutnya dengan lebih baik.

learningNotes: give instructions berarti memberi instruksi atau petunjuk.
Feedback tidak memakai s. Gunakan some feedback atau a piece of feedback.
Gunakan give instructions about atau for + hal: instructions about the safety check.
